messages.content: Help me apply a function named 'processType' to each type in a union type object named 'unionTypeObj' to analyze its properties?

function.name: forEachType
function.description: This function iterates over each type in a given type object, applying a specified function to it. If the type object represents a union of types, the function is applied to each type in the union; otherwise, it is applied directly to the single type. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

type.description: The type object, potentially representing a union of types. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

f.description: The function to apply to each type in the type object. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.
